_about: The prompts the AI visibility step asks every platform, edited here without touching code. Placeholders: {city}, {state} (full name), {st} (two letters), {practice}, {service}. Service prompts repeat for each service the site has a page for (up to maxServices). The methodology appendix lists the exact prompts that ran.
_informational: Everyday questions don't name the town, so AI tools almost never answer them with a local practice. Three are kept as a small sample for the blog finding; they are not part of the headline 'AI recommends you' number. Each question costs about 7 cents a run across the six AI tools.
